<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Discarten — Lista de Precios</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --carbon: #211d1a;
    --carbon-suave: #2b2521;
    --crema: #f6efe3;
    --crema-suave: #efe4d1;
    --rojo: #9c2b1f;
    --rojo-vivo: #b8362a;
    --oro: #c08a35;
    --oro-suave: #d9b876;
    --linea: rgba(255,255,255,0.09);
    --linea-clara: rgba(33,29,26,0.1);
  }
  *{ box-sizing: border-box; }
  body{
    margin:0;
    background: #d8cfc0;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
    color: var(--carbon);
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .hoja{
    max-width: 1240px;
    margin: 24px auto;
    background: var(--crema);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
  }

  /* ===== CABECERA ===== */
  .cabecera{
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--carbon) 0%, #17130f 100%);
    color: var(--crema);
    padding: 44px 40px 36px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .cabecera::after{
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    right:-60px; top:-60px;
    width:260px; height:260px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(192,138,53,0.16) 0%, transparent 70%);
  }
  .marca-fila{
    display:flex;
    align-items:baseline;
    justify-content: space-between;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 12px;
    position:relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }
  .logo-img{
    display:block;
    max-width: 340px;
    width: 100%;
    height:auto;
    border-radius: 4px;
  }
  .eslogan{
    font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
    font-style: italic;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    color: var(--oro-suave);
    margin: 4px 0 0;
  }
  .sellos{
    display:flex;
    gap: 22px;
    margin-top: 22px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    position:relative;
    z-index:1;
  }
  .sello{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:8px;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
    color: var(--crema-suave);
    padding: 7px 14px;
    border: 1px solid var(--linea);
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
  }

  /* ===== DATOS DE CONTACTO ===== */
  .datos{
    background: var(--oro);
    color: var(--carbon);
    text-align:center;
    padding: 11px 20px;
    font-size: 0.88rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.2px;
  }

  /* ===== INFO REPARTO / PEDIDOS ===== */
  .info-franja{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--linea-clara);
  }
  .info-bloque{
    padding: 20px 40px;
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    line-height: 1.7;
  }
  .info-bloque:first-child{ border-right: 1px solid var(--linea-clara); }
  .info-titulo{
    font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.02rem;
    color: var(--rojo);
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:8px;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .info-bloque strong{ color: var(--carbon); }

  /* ===== LLAMADA A LA ACCIÓN ===== */
  .cta{
    background: var(--rojo);
    color: var(--crema);
    text-align:center;
    padding: 16px 20px;
    font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .cta a{ color: var(--oro-suave); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--oro-suave); }

  /* ===== COLUMNAS DE PRODUCTOS ===== */
  .columnas{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 0;
  }
  .columna{ padding: 34px 40px; }
  .columna:first-child{ border-right: 1px solid var(--linea-clara); }

  .familia{ margin-bottom: 34px; }
  .familia:last-child{ margin-bottom: 0; }

  .familia-cab{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding-bottom: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--carbon);
  }
  .familia-emoji{ font-size: 1.4rem; line-height:1; display:flex; align-items:center; }
  .familia-icono svg{ display:block; }
  .familia-nombre{
    font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.18rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.2px;
    color: var(--carbon);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  table{ width:100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
  thead th{ padding:0; border:none; height:0; line-height:0; }
  thead .th-cant{
    text-align:right;
    font-size: 0.68rem;
    color:#8a7d6c;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    height:auto;
    line-height:normal;
    padding: 0 4px 4px;
  }
  tr{ border-bottom: 1px solid var(--linea-clara); }
  tr:last-child{ border-bottom: none; }
  tr:hover td{ background: var(--crema-suave); }
  td.cantidad-col{ width: 108px; padding: 6px 4px; }
  .stepper{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:flex-end;
    gap: 4px;
  }
  .stepper button{
    width: 24px; height: 24px;
    border-radius: 5px;
    border: 1px solid var(--rojo);
    background: var(--crema);
    color: var(--rojo);
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 1;
    cursor: pointer;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    padding:0;
    flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .stepper button:active{ background: var(--rojo); color: var(--crema); }
  .qty-input{
    width: 40px;
    text-align:center;
    border: 1px solid var(--linea-clara);
    border-radius: 5px;
    padding: 3px 2px;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: var(--carbon);
    background: #fff;
    -moz-appearance: textfield;
  }
  .qty-input::-webkit-outer-spin-button,
  .qty-input::-webkit-inner-spin-button{ -webkit-appearance:none; margin:0; }
  tr.fila-pedido.con-cantidad td{ background: rgba(192,138,53,0.12); }

  /* ===== BARRA DE RESUMEN / PEDIDO ===== */
  .barra-pedido{
    position: sticky;
    bottom: 0;
    z-index: 20;
    background: var(--carbon);
    color: var(--crema);
    padding: 14px 24px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 16px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    box-shadow: 0 -6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
  }
  .barra-info{ font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--crema-suave); }
  .barra-info strong{ color: var(--oro-suave); font-size: 1.15rem; }
  .barra-botones{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap: 10px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .btn-limpiar{
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--crema-suave);
    border: 1px solid var(--linea);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 12px 20px;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 0.88rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap: 6px;
    transition: background 0.12s ease;
  }
  .btn-limpiar:hover{ background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
  .btn-enviar{
    background: var(--oro);
    color: var(--carbon);
    border: none;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 12px 26px;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap: 8px;
    transition: transform 0.12s ease;
  }
  .btn-enviar:hover{ transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .btn-enviar:disabled{ opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; transform:none; }
  td{
    padding: 9px 4px;
    font-size: 0.93rem;
    vertical-align: middle;
  }
  td.nombre{ color: #3a332c; font-weight: 700; }
  td.precio{
    text-align:right;
    color: var(--rojo);
    font-weight: 800;
    white-space: nowrap;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  .unidad{ font-weight:500; color:#8a7d6c; font-size:0.82rem; }

  .ref-code{
    display:block;
    font-size: 0.68rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #a89a85;
    letter-spacing: 0.2px;
    margin-bottom: 1px;
  }
  .etq{
    display:inline-block;
    font-size: 0.62rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    margin-left: 8px;
    vertical-align: middle;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .etq-nuevo{ background: var(--oro); color: var(--carbon); }
  .etq-top{ background: var(--carbon); color: var(--oro-suave); }

  /* ===== PIE ===== */
  .pie{
    background: var(--carbon);
    color: var(--crema-suave);
    text-align:center;
    padding: 22px 20px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .pie strong{ color: var(--oro-suave); }

  @media (max-width: 820px){
    .columnas, .info-franja{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .columna:first-child, .info-bloque:first-child{ border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--linea-clara); }
    .logo-txt{ font-size: 2.4rem; }
  }
</style>
</head>
